info.what: Follows a single request as it travels through every service, timing each step.
info.why: With many services involved, it shows exactly where a slow or failed request got stuck.
info.analogy: A parcel-tracking page showing every stop along the way.

samples.caption: One request, step by step: payments is where the time goes
samples.code:
GET /checkout            480 ms
├ api-gateway              5 ms
├ orders                  60 ms
│ └ SELECT orders         40 ms
├ payments               390 ms ←
│ └ POST bank API        370 ms
└ queue email              2 ms

samples.caption: Every call passes on the trace id, so the steps can be joined up
